title: Companion Lys is teased across multiple holds via bracketed asides ('Lys +1, when word reaches them') starting in Act 1, but per the end-game epilogue was waiting the entire game at the Vale's hunter's camp (west of Split Oak) — a location no dialogue or notice board ever names outright. A whole companion can be permanently and silently missed.
where: Last Light Square (talking to reeve) / end-game status epilogue
